# Nota

> Nota is lossless AsciiDoc for TypeScript: a parser that keeps every byte of the source, an HTML converter compatible with Asciidoctor, and visual and source editors on top of them.

Alpha (0.x), packages `@nota-adoc/*`. Paths are relative to the root of the repository.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, layout, rules and pitfalls for an AI assistant
- [README.md](README.md): what Nota is, the packages, a first example
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): requirements, build, tests by group, quality tools

## Packages

- [packages/core/README.md](packages/core/README.md): the parser, tree, diagnostics, ASG, sessions and edit operations
- [packages/html/README.md](packages/html/README.md): the HTML converter, what it writes and what it leaves to the host
- [packages/codemirror/README.md](packages/codemirror/README.md): AsciiDoc for CodeMirror 6
- [packages/prosemirror/README.md](packages/prosemirror/README.md): the visual editor on ProseMirror
- [packages/react/README.md](packages/react/README.md): React controls for the visual editor
- [packages/vscode/README.md](packages/vscode/README.md): the VS Code extension

## Comparison with Asciidoctor

- [docs/asciidoctor-differences.md](docs/asciidoctor-differences.md): what is supported, what is not, and where the behaviour differs

## Examples

- [examples/parse.ts](examples/parse.ts): parse a text without loss and read the diagnostics
- [examples/walk.ts](examples/walk.ts): walk the syntax tree and list the outline
- [examples/render.ts](examples/render.ts): render a document to HTML
